result.document_summary: Massachusetts G.L. c. 186 § 31, which requires a notice to quit for nonpayment of rent to be accompanied by a state-developed form with rental assistance and legal information, and bars courts from accepting summary process filings without proof of delivery of that form.
result.notes: The section sets a procedural notice and filing requirement for nonpayment evictions. It does not set allowed eviction causes, notice periods, relocation assistance or coverage limits, so it was not recorded as a just_cause_eviction regime, and no other in-scope category (rent limits, deposits, fees, screening, algorithmic pricing) is addressed. Returning an empty list is a conservative choice; a reviewer may wish to treat the notice-form requirement as an eviction-procedure rule if the project scope is read more broadly.
